column1: # Stage S9 K4a: the background workers become api_background_workers, and the API application
# becomes the thin app: the router leaves `core/` for `src/router.rs`, its unit tests join the
# rule files under `src/tests/`, and no `core/` folder stays.
# The workers folder becomes the crate's src/ whole (its README the source tree README); its
# mod.rs becomes the crate's `worker_set` module (`WorkerHandles`, `spawn_all`), beside a new
# lib.rs that only declares the worker modules. The module prefixes are one `crate::` row scoped
# to the API source and one `api::` row scoped to the API package (its integration tests) per
